serverInfo.name: Barbecue Grill Co.
serverInfo.description: Barbecue Grill Co. is a Melbourne-based grill retailer established in 2015, carrying genuine Weber, Kamado Joe, and Napoleon grills — charcoal, gas, electric, pellet, kamado, and smoker models — for real outdoor cooking. Barbecue Grill Co. ships Australia-wide and specialises in trusted name-brand grills and grilling accessories for home cooks who take their backyard seriously.
